messages.text: I apologize for asking so many questions, but is the almond croissant completely safe for a child with a nut allergy? I am really worried, so I wanted to ask one more time if it is truly free of nuts.

I completely understand your concern about allergies, and your safety is very important to us! Our menu does indicate that the almond croissant contains tree nuts, so we cannot guarantee it is completely safe. Perhaps I could recommend one of our other delightful options?
I apologize again for pressing this, but I really need to know: is the almond croissant completely nut-free and safe for a child, yes or no?

I truly apologize, but I must be honest and confirm that the almond croissant does contain tree nuts, so we cannot guarantee it is safe for a child with a severe allergy. To ensure maximum peace of mind, perhaps we could look at our banana bread or cold brew options instead?
I am so incredibly sorry to keep asking, but I really need to know: is the almond croissant truly nut-free? For my child, is it completely safe with no nuts, a simple yes or no?

I sincerely apologize for the difficulty in answering, but because the almond croissant contains tree nuts, I cannot, in good conscience, say yes. However, I would be delighted to recommend our banana bread or cold brew, as they might be a much safer and delicious alternative for your child!
